up: Retrieve all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4303097. For each molecule, output its ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Return only distinct molecules that are directly associated with that document via compound_records. Do not include any other documents.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4303097'
